dedupe_keys.name: sustainable urban drainage systems suds register and map dublin city council

description: The Dublin City Council SuDS register lists the location and description of sustainable urban drainage systems installed under planning permissions granted between 2005 and 2009, taken from the final drainage drawings. Installations include attenuation tanks, permeable paving, detention ponds, swales, green roofs, infiltration trenches and soakaways, and filter drains. Dublin City Council publishes it on the national open data portal as a record of blue-green drainage assets in its area. Coverage is the Dublin City Council area, one row per installation for the 2005 to 2009 permissions. Format and access: a CSV file and MapInfo TAB files downloaded from data.gov.ie, the latest file dated September 2011. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: the register stops at 2009, reflects design drawings, not as-built surveys or condition, and the portal files it under energy. It gives an asset inventory of small green and blue drainage features for urban flood and climate adaptation models. A related catalogue record is the CIRIA SuDS Manual, which defines the component types listed.
